subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A system designed to stop cheating can create new problems if it treats every student as suspicious.”?
options: Good predictions include both knowledge and limits.
Without trust, even exact numbers lose power.
Having fun is good, but choices still matter.
Good testing measures learning without ignoring dignity.
